rationale: The DesignIR child-update planner (core/view/src/design_update.cpp and its header) now keeps the shared prefix, suffix and longest increasing run of surviving keyed children in place and reports per-child key diagnostics when keys are ambiguous. It is a pure planning function with no production caller; the plan contract (removals first, directly applicable indices) and the wholesale-replace fallback are unchanged. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'ambiguous keys report the reason and location of each offender'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'keyed mutation corpus moves only children outside the longest increasing run'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'keyed update indices remain safe for direct application'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'seeded random keyed permutations match the reference minimum'
